response.justification: The candidate clearly exceeds the software development experience bar (15+ years) and has genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth — authoring a test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure, device orchestration tooling, and teaching TDD/Selenium/CI courses. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position, and the resume shows no evidence of formal people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or team leadership; titles are consistently individual-contributor (Senior/Staff Software Engineer), and the founder role appears to be a solo open-source project rather than an organization with reports. Mobile-platform exposure is thin and dated (iOS/Apple TV work in 2015-2016), and there is no demonstrated experience with roadmap ownership or organizational change. Worth a conversation only if the team is open to a first-time manager with strong tooling credibility; otherwise the management gap is disqualifying.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tooling and test-infrastructure experience (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, DevOps)
15+ years of broad software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, embedded, and high-throughput backends
Strong mentoring/teaching signal: workshops, conference talks, code katas, multi-module Selenium/TDD courses
concerns: No demonstrated people management experience — misses the 2-year minimum outright
No evidence of formal technical leadership scope, team roadmaps, or leading organizational change
Limited and dated mobile-platform experience; no large-scale mobile ecosystem exposure

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure depth
No demonstrated roadmap or org-level leadership scope
